compare_models() accepts already fitted models; it does not automatically
construct or choose reflective, antecedent, or alternative-factor models.
Comparisons on different observed variable sets must not mechanically rank
ordinary AIC/BIC. Common-variable covariance error requires exactly the stated
variables in each model and held-out data. Failed models remain explicit rows.

This is a method note; it contains no survey observations or empirical results.
